subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.

They appointed him as the manager, as he was due for __an__ promotion.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the omission of the article "**a**" before the term "**promotion**."
 
• Singular countable nouns typically require an article ("a" or "an").
 
• The correct phrase should be "**due for a promotion**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part B** of the sentence.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

**Correct Sentence:** *"They appointed him as the manager, as he was **due for a promotion**."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **A: "They appointed him as the manager," **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **C: "as he was due for" **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **D: "promotion." **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.`
